name: Ranger: Skirmish moves the displayed crit chance by 15 and real attacks by 15, not 30 (#10401)
contract: Skirmish (802039) tooltip: 'Increases your critical strike chance by $s2%...'. Effect 1 applies SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE (aura 350, MiscValue 127, all schools). EffectBasePoints 14 with DieSides 1 gives AuraEffect::GetAmount() 15, confirmed with aura_amount. AuraEffect::HandleAscensionModCritChance recomputes PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE, PLAYER_OFFHAND_CRIT_PERCENTAGE and PLAYER_RANGED_CRIT_PERCENTAGE on apply and remove, and Player::UpdateCritPercentage folds the aura's physical part into them, so the character pane shows Skirmish (melee_crit_chance). A player's real rolls start from those same fields: Unit::GetUnitCriticalChance for auto attacks (ranged_taken_crit_chance, RANGED_ATTACK against a level 60 dummy) and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance for melee and ranged class spells (spell_done_crit_chance on Heroic Strike 78, DmgClass melee, physical, no Ranger spell mods). Neither may add aura 350's physical part a second time, so every metric must fall by exactly 15 when Skirmish is removed; a roll path that adds it again falls by 30. Skirmish's DurationIndex is 0; live, a script sets its duration from Advantage stacks, which set_aura bypasses, so set_aura gives a fixture aura with max duration 0 a 60 s lifetime. Crit ratings keep every value above the 0 floor without a weapon.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Apply Skirmish directly as a fixture aura
SETUP: Skirmish's crit effect amount is 15
Removing Skirmish drops the displayed melee crit chance by its 15-point effect amount
Ranged auto attacks lose exactly 15 crit chance, not 30
A physical melee spell loses exactly 15 crit chance, not 30
